name: Pumpkin Patch — Mothlight WebGPU

validation.scope: Exact final HTML; normal native game RAF and actual software Dawn WebGPU/WebGL execution. Software GPU and injected controller QA do not certify physical Fold, TV, Bluetooth or device FPS.

renderer_coverage.village: Automatic WebGPU when the secure browser exposes a compatible adapter and the full first frame validates; original WebGL fallback otherwise.
renderer_coverage.canonical_village_atlas: Retained WebGL snapshot with exact source restoration
